subject: CAIQ control linkage and sample evidence handoff - Primed Insurance
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@primed-insurance.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-02T14:08:00Z
Subject: CAIQ: primary scope, control owners and initial evidence request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Primed's compliance team has started the CAIQ review and asked for an initial crosswalk plus a small evidence sample set so their auditors can get a sense of our operational controls. Two asks from them:

1) A mapping that ties our CAIQ answers to specific control owners and where the supporting artifacts live (drive link or artifact id).
2) A short sample bundle (no PII) showing runtime logs, an access review report, and any KV/cache eviction evidence for a typical tenant — they want files they can spot-check, not full exports.

Can you confirm:
- who will own the control-by-control handoff on our side,
- whether we can provide a one-day sample window (they suggested Feb 28), and
- whether we should send via a shared Drive link or DocuSign-secured package?

We need the mapping and evidence by COB Friday their time to keep the audit timeline. Marking secops@primed-insurance.com on this thread.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Security Programs
Primed Insurance

(attachment: questionnaire_excerpt.pdf)

Elena — thanks for the clear asks.

High-level plan:
- I'll own the coordination and final delivery on the sales side.
- Kimberly will confirm the mapping and owner roster for each CAIQ control.
- Marissa will help with any contractual or attestation language they require.

I've attached an initial mapping (primed_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx) that pairs our CAIQ answers to proposed control owners and shows candidate artifact locations (Drive ids). It's a work-in-progress but should give your auditors enough to start.

For the sample bundle: we can do a one-day window for Feb 28 and provide a sanitized logs manifest + a KV cache snapshot and a redacted access review PDF. Those are small files — would you prefer a shared Drive folder (link below) or an encrypted package via DocuSign? We can do either; Drive is fastest.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCxyz-primed-evidence

Attachments: primed_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx

I'll sync with Kimberly now and follow up within a couple hours with a confirmed artifact list.

Thanks,
